# A Repair That Knows When to Go

The fifth pre-release for [#57](https://github.com/timmaurice/bergfex/issues/57). It fixes a repair that stayed after its cause was gone.

## The "requests refused" repair

- **A leftover repair now clears itself on restart.** _[#58]_ The repair is kept across restarts so you see it even when it was raised while nobody was looking. The count of refusals behind it, however, starts from zero after a restart. Once every entry had moved off a refused host, which is the way out the repair itself suggests, nothing polled that host any more, and nothing ever cleared the repair. On each start the integration now drops any "requests refused" repair that nothing in the current run backs up.
- **A block that is still there is reported again.** If a host still refuses an entry that uses it, the repair comes back after five refused polls, as before.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do beyond the usual restart. If you moved your German resorts to another language after `beta.3` and the `www.bergfex.de` repair stayed, it is gone after this update and a restart.
